name: nod
description: A Stellar USDC wallet with an allowance for your AI: small payments go through on their own, anything bigger waits for your nod (your passkey).

interface.shortDescription: Give your AI an allowance. Big stuff needs your nod.
interface.longDescription: Nod is a passkey-owned Stellar wallet you connect to your AI. Set an allowance (say 5 USDC until tomorrow) and your AI can pay people and paid APIs (x402) inside it on its own. Anything bigger comes back to you as a link your passkey approves for that exact recipient and amount. Nod tells this chat when money arrives, when someone asks you for money and when a payment settles. Stellar testnet.
defaultPrompt: How much can you spend from my Nod wallet?
Tell me here when someone sends me money
